summary: The system implements a user interface for managing and generating confirmation letters related to placements, courses, and departments. It involves dynamic dropdowns for departments, programs, and terms, checkbox selections for additional options, and a final report generation button.
purpose: To facilitate the creation and management of confirmation letters for placement schedules, allowing users to select relevant parameters such as departments, programs, terms, and optional settings before generating the confirmation report.

workflows.name: Department Selection
steps: User selects a department from the dropdown.
Programs and terms are dynamically loaded based on the selected department.

workflows.name: Program Selection
steps: User selects a program from the dropdown.
Terms are dynamically loaded based on the selected program.

workflows.name: Run Report
steps: A confirmation letter creation job is initiated with the selected parameters.

business_rules.description: Load all departments if the user has permission to access all; otherwise, load specific departments.
Load all programs if the user has permission to access all; otherwise, load specific programs.

validations: Ensure UserSession is not null before proceeding with data operations.
Custom validators validate specific fields before report generation.
conditions: If UserSession is null, cancel data loading operations for ObjectDataSource.
system_behavior: The system populates dropdowns based on user selections and permissions.
The system validates user inputs before initiating report generation.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for managing user session data.
ScriptManager for handling JavaScript setup during postbacks.
exceptions: Cancel data operations if the user session is null.
